CRYSTAL CROP PROTECTION IPO SUBSCRIBED 17.68X ON FINAL DAY

Crystal Crop Protection’s IPO attracted strong investor interest on 20 November 2026. HDFC Sky reported the issue was subscribed *17.68* times on the final day, while BusinessLine noted an earlier tally of *8.55* times.
The issue includes a fresh share sale and an offer for sale, with proceeds earmarked for debt repayment and acquisitions, according to BusinessLine.

For information only. Not investment advice.
